items.title: Is Cigna Group (CI) Undervalued Following Its UBS Healthcare Conference Update?
items.summary: Cigna Group (CI) is back in focus after Executive VP and CFO Ann M. Dennison spoke at the 2026 UBS Global Healthcare Conference in Palm Beach Gardens on November 10. The recent conference appearance comes as Cigna Group trades at US$273.04, with the share price down 10.95% over the past 30 days and 7.84% over the last week. However, the 1 year total shareholder return of 3.57% and 5 year total shareholder return of 42.29% point to longer term momentum that has been steadier than the latest...
